text:
alex: quick preflight for onboarding gpt-small-v2.1 — want to run through weights location, tokenizer quirks, and pin/canary plan. pinging infra + runtime.

priya: thanks. can you paste the exact S3 path and manifest checksum? :eyes: we need that for the private deploy checklist.

alex: weights -> s3://redwood-models/gpt-small/v2.1/ (shard-0000.pt .. shard-0003.pt). manifest: models/gpt-small/v2.1/manifest.json (sha256: b3f9a7c2...). I uploaded a small manifest with checksums.

sam: putting the catalog config I plan to upload to the staging catalog:
```yaml
model_id: gpt-small
version: v2.1
weights_uri: s3://redwood-models/gpt-small/v2.1/
tokenizer_uri: s3://redwood-models/gpt-small/v2.1/tokenizer.model
pin: v2.1
canary:
  regions: [us-east-1]
  traffic_pct: 5
fallbacks:
  - gpt-small-v2.0-quant
```

jordan: quick note — tokenizer.model is sentencepiece. Kai found an index-shift on unk/cls ids in the runtime wrapper last week, remember? we need to validate token ids mapping on the compiled tokenizer used by the serving runtime.

kai: confirmed. local unit test: token ids differ by +1 for tokens > 10000 when using legacy SP wrapper vs new fast-spm. reproducer: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; ..."` — will drop small repro in PR. saw ~0.6% tokenization delta on sample corpus.

priya: that's worrying for client regressions. can we add a quick eval against the golden prompt set (prompt_set/canary_v2.json) and check LM perplexity + important token-level diffs?

sam: yes, I scheduled a quick canary eval job (low-cost). results will show basic pass/fail for token id alignment and topk token diffs. will post link.

alex: routing/fallback plan: start canary at us-east-1 5% traffic, then expand to eu-west-1 if metrics stable. fallback variant is gpt-small-v2.0-quant (lower cost). we will pin user-facing catalog entries to v2.1 after canary + 24h stable.

jordan: please include rollout-timestamp in the catalog entry so we can audit. also ensure the rollout config contains an automatic fallback threshold (error_rate > 1% or latency P95 > 1200ms).

sam: added these fields to the PR draft. snippet: 
```json
{"rollout": {"start_ts": "2026-03-18T16:30:00Z", "traffic_pct": 5, "fallback_policy": {"error_rate_pct": 1.0, "latency_p95_ms": 1200}}}
```

kai: FYI the tokenizer repro PR is at https://git.redwood.ai/r/tokenizers/pull/42 — it includes a tiny migration helper that remaps ids if older models are detected. would prefer we avoid automatic remap for now; better to standardize tokenizers on ingestion.

priya: agree. ingestion-time validation + rejection is safer. can we add an ingestion validator that checks: vocab_size matches manifest, special token ids in expected slots, and sample tokenization parity against the fast-spm?

alex: yes — target: block catalog publish if validator fails. can we do a lightweight parity check (<2s) that runs in the upload pipeline?

sam: should be doable. I'll add a pipeline step that downloads tokenizer.model, runs 100 short prompts from prompt_set/ingest_smoke.json and compares token sequences to the golden fast-spm binary.

jordan: code-review ping @sam — please request my review on the catalog PR and the ingestion validator. also cc @alex for rollout strategy signoff. :thumbsup:

sam: PRs open: catalog entry https://git.redwood.ai/r/catalog/pulls/118 and ingest validator https://git.redwood.ai/r/platform/pulls/446. tests in CI pass locally for me.

deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: catalog-canary/gpt-small-v2.1 -> start 2026-03-18T16:30Z, regions: [us-east-1], traffic: 5%

kai: ran a small live smoke on staging runtime 1.9 with v2.1 weights -> saw identical logits for 98.9% of tokens vs local reference when using the fast-spm tokenizer. mismatch cluster concentrated around emojis & long-tail tokens.

priya: OK, next steps: 1) sam merges ingestion validator + catalog PR after jordan + alex approve, 2) run canary eval + smoke (sam/kai), 3) wait 24h stability, 4) pin catalog and enable eu-west-1. please reply with A+ if you ack each step.

alex: A+ on plan.

jordan: A+ will review PRs today.

sam: A+ I'll merge once approvals and CI green. kicking off the eval job now (link will follow).

kai: A+ will monitor token diffs and smoke logs.

alex: awesome — thanks all. dropping the manifest link here: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-models/gpt-small/v2.1/manifest.json (internal-only).
